name: COMP_026
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (95%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Invasive only and the second model agrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 95%, InSitu 4% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 88th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive | One InSitu neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 2, 3) · ↑ invasive · Top invasive-associated concept; spot check 19/20 [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 4, 5, 7) · context · Descriptive only; spot check 8/20 [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 3, 5, 7) · ↑ invasive · Flagged weak; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 3, 5, 7) · ↑ invasive · Small term; spot check 18/20 · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference is +0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier. This case leans on Unreliable normal lobules and mitoses.

## Could be wrong if
- Regions 1–3 are not true invasion; the closest InSitu reference, BACH_0124, is similar (0.83).
- Calibration was tested on only 132 images; ECE 5%, CI 3–18%.

## Check on the slide
1. **1, 2, 3** Confirm the stroma is true invasion, not reactive stroma.
2. **0, 1, 2, 3** Verify simulated superior-margin tumor; also medial (0, 4) and lateral (3, 7) [F7].
3. **4, 5, 7** Lymphocyte, necrosis and mitosis scores peak here; spot checks were poor, so confirm directly.
